notes: Typst publication checks independent raw, optimized/stripped, gzip and Brotli ceilings. The November 11 art-preset reassessment updates only raw and stripped ceilings using measured bytes plus 3%, rounded upward to 1,000 bytes. Compression uses the final stripped artifact. Web and Playground artifact sizes are reported without ceilings. Historical Web measurements and retired budget decisions remain in docs/performance/binding_wasm_budget_2026-11-01.md; Typst decisions remain in docs/performance/typst_theme_budget_2026-11-05.md and docs/performance/dependency_wasm_budget_2026-11-06.md.
